paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.14, with a change of -4.06% from the prior close and 0.33% over a window of 21 sessions. There have been 6 new news articles in the last 24 hours. Recent news headlines include "FRMI Stock Tests Support As Cash Burn Raises Questions" and "Fermi Shares Fall After Receiving Subpoena From Eastern District of New York Over Project Matador".

The recent news is driven by Fermi Inc.'s receipt of a subpoena from the US District Court for the Eastern District of New York related to Project Matador, a data center campus the company is developing in west Texas. This news has caused the stock to decline, with some articles reporting a drop of 3.1% to 4.3% in Monday's trading.

There have been various SEC filings from Fermi Inc., including a 10-Q form reporting a net loss for the second quarter of 2026, and an 8-K form announcing the appointment of Lee McIntire as the new Chief Executive Officer. There has been one Form 4 filing and no Form 144 filings. Social posts include discussions of buying and swinging the stock, with some users expressing optimism about the company's potential.
